scope: Additive TH18 regular Valkyrie direct-parent and grounded area-attack baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3. The immutable upstream payload at commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba supplies matching L1-L11 parent statistics; the frozen 2026-09-17 observation supplies L12.

sources.title: Valkyrie
sources.limitations: The dated page reports the L1-L12 HP, DPS, research cost/time and Town Hall table and identifies ground-only targets, no target preference, housing 8, speed 24, 1.8-second cadence, melee range and a circular area attack. It does not provide an exact area radius, deterministic target ties, route selection, contact geometry, first-hit delay, retargeting, spell/trap ordering or visual timing.

sources.title: Valkyrie
sources.limitations: The indexed page corroborates the one-tile, ground-only area splash radius, housing 8, movement speed 24, 1.8-second cadence and 0.5-tile range. The page does not identify a current client build and was unavailable for direct fetch, so it is not used to replace numeric level data.

sources.title: Home Village Valkyrie structured troop record
sources.limitations: The pinned payload supplies L1-L11, ground-only splash classification, housing, speed, cadence and range but no L12 record or deterministic area/collision contract.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes
sources.limitations: Officially establishes L10 at TH15 with 2,400 HP and 223 DPS, but no targeting or geometry contract.

sources.title: New In Town Hall 16!
sources.limitations: Officially announces L11 at TH16 as 2,800 HP and 240 DPS. Its historical HP conflicts with the current build-pinned secondary table's 2,600 HP/238 DPS; neither value is silently rewritten and the current table remains separately marked secondary.

sources.title: The Sound of Clash Update
sources.limitations: Officially establishes Valkyrie L12 but publishes no numeric table or deterministic combat mechanics.

support.note: Core materializes the existing immutable L1-L12 ground direct parent, its sourced 1.8-second damage and the Fandom-corroborated one-tile ground splash through the same BattleState used by Headless, Viewer and RL.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L1-L12 parent despite source-backed generic Core ground splash and adapter materialization.
changed_values.replacement: The existing L1-L12 table, ground-only area attack and one-tile splash are current-source-audited and classified as an executable shared-Core baseline with focused snapshot, replay, determinism and Headless coverage.
changed_values.justification: Published parent values and qualitative area behavior support the existing generic Core path. The historical L11 official/current-secondary discrepancy is retained rather than inferred away.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines equal-distance target ties, approach and path costs, target-loss, retarget timing, attack wind-up or first-hit delay, contact/collision geometry, exact splash-center rounding, spell stacking, trap ordering or same-tick ordering.

The current build-pinned secondary L11 record is 2,600 HP and 238 DPS, while Supercell's December 2023 launch note was 2,800 HP and 240 DPS. No dated primary note explaining the later values was found; the active numeric record stays secondary and the conflict is preserved.

No consulted source supplies a primary current L1-L12 numeric table, fixed-tick motion/attack animation, asset validation for L12, projectile/contact visual timing or proof that the Core's generic nearest-target/path model reproduces client route choices.
conclusion: Valkyrie L1-L12 is executable as a source-bounded ground area-attack direct parent through Core, Headless CLI, Viewer and RL. Its generic Core splash is limited to the separately corroborated one-tile ground radius; pathing, timing, collisions, interactions, the L11 historical discrepancy and visual fidelity remain partial.
